words.example: This week, shift last year's minutes across into the archive folder.
words.exampleZh: 本周请把去年的会议纪要移到归档文件夹。

words.example: Ask families to reply to the shared mailbox rather than to one person.
words.exampleZh: 请家属回复共享邮箱，不要回复某一个人。

words.example: Use the group email for the holiday roster instead of separate messages.
words.exampleZh: 假期排班请发到组邮箱，不要一封封分开写。

words.example: A clear subject line and a polite greeting are basic email etiquette.
words.exampleZh: 主题清楚、问候得体，这是基本的邮件礼仪。

words.example: Families will understand the notice better if we use plain language.
words.exampleZh: 如果我们用通俗表达来写，家属会更容易看懂这份通知。

words.example: Quote the circuit ID when you call the carrier about the east campus outage.
words.exampleZh: 给运营商报东院区中断时，把专线编号一起报上。

words.example: The carrier swapped the failed fiber pair at the east campus handoff.
words.exampleZh: 运营商在东院区的交接点换掉了那对故障光纤。

words.meaning: 边界网关协议（Border Gateway Protocol）
words.example: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) dropped the east campus prefix for twelve minutes.
words.exampleZh: BGP（边界网关协议）把东院区前缀撤掉了十二分钟。

words.meaning: 开放最短路径优先（Open Shortest Path First）
words.example: OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) reconverged after the core link came back.
words.exampleZh: 核心链路恢复后，OSPF（开放最短路径优先）重新收敛了。

words.example: A static route on the lab firewall still points at the retired gateway.
words.exampleZh: 实验室防火墙上有一条静态路由还指向已退役的网关。
